mapper.select: SELECT fa.child_id AS childId, fa.financial_account_id AS accountId, fa.child_available_amount AS budgetAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tx.direction = 'DEBIT' AND tx.occurred_at >= #{startOccurredAt} AND tx.occurred_at < #{endOccurredAtExclusive} THEN tx.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS spentAmount FROM financial_account fa LEFT JOIN account_transaction tx ON tx.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id WHERE fa.owner_type = 'CHILD' AND fa.account_product_type = 'DEMAND_DEPOSIT' AND fa.account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fa.link_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fa.child_access_mode = 'CO_MANAGED' AND fa.child_available_amount IS NOT NULL AND fa.child_available_amount > 0 GROUP BY fa.child_id, fa.financial_account_id, fa.child_available_amount HAVING spentAmount >= fa.child_available_amount
SELECT time_capsule_id AS timeCapsuleId, child_id AS childId, title FROM time_capsule WHERE status = 'COLLECTING' AND expected_release_at IS NOT NULL AND expected_release_at <= #{now}

SELECT cp.member_id FROM child_parent cp INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = cp.member_id WHERE cp.child_id = #{childId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.member_type = 'PARENT' AND COALESCE(( SELECT np.enabled FROM notification_preference np WHERE np.member_id = cp.member_id AND np.notification_category = #{category} ), 1) = 1
